description: End-to-end telco CRM customer retention workflow from risk detection to offer execution and follow-up.

interaction_id.description: Identifier for a specific customer interaction (call, chat, store visit)

value.description: Phone number, email address, or address ID

preferred.description: Whether this is the preferred contact point

functions.name: identify_at_risk_customers
functions.description: Search and score customers at risk of churn based on filters and churn model.

segment_filters.description: Filters to constrain search space before scoring.

risk_band.description: Minimum churn risk band to include.

functions.returns: List of at-risk customer_ids with churn scores, basic profile, and optional subscription summaries.

functions.name: get_customer_retention_profile
functions.description: Retrieve a 360° retention profile for a customer including churn risk, usage, complaints, and current commitments.
functions.returns: Comprehensive retention-oriented customer profile including churn_risk_score, key factors, subscriptions, and interaction history.

functions.name: open_retention_case
functions.description: Create a new retention case for a customer, typically when they express intent to cancel or are flagged high risk.

interaction_context.description: Context of the interaction where the case was opened.

initial_reason_codes.description: Initial classification of why the customer is at risk.

functions.returns: New retention_case object including case_id, status, and initial prioritization.

functions.name: recommend_retention_offers
functions.description: Generate personalized retention offer recommendations for a specific case.
functions.returns: Ranked list of offer candidates with offer_id, projected impact, revenue effect, and eligibility rationale.

functions.name: get_offer_details
functions.description: Retrieve full details and eligibility for a specific retention offer for a customer.
functions.returns: Full offer definition including benefits, commitments, pricing changes, and eligibility result for the given customer and case.

functions.name: negotiate_custom_offer
functions.description: Construct and validate a custom retention offer proposal outside of standard catalog, with guardrails.

base_offer_id.description: Optional catalog offer to use as baseline.

applied_bill_cycle.description: Bill cycle identifier or YYYY-MM format.

functions.returns: Validation result with projected revenue impact, policy compliance check, required approvals, and a provisional offer_id if allowed.

functions.name: present_and_capture_offer_decision
functions.description: Record which offer was presented to the customer and capture their decision and feedback.

reason_code.description: If rejected or deferred, capture main reason.

best_time_window.description: Free text or standardized time window label.

functions.returns: Updated case with recorded offer presentation, decision outcome, and any scheduled follow-up tasks.

functions.name: activate_retention_offer
functions.description: Apply an accepted retention offer to the customer account and subscriptions.

effective_date.description: If omitted, defaults to immediate or next bill cycle per policy.

dry_run.description: If true, only simulate changes without committing.

functions.returns: Activation result including applied changes per subscription, billing adjustments, and updated case status.

functions.name: get_retention_case
functions.description: Retrieve current status and history of a retention case.
functions.returns: Retention_case object with optional event timeline, interactions, and associated offers.

functions.name: update_retention_case
functions.description: Modify properties or add notes to an existing retention case.

notes.description: Append one or more notes to the case.

next_action.description: Optional update to next planned action.

functions.returns: Updated retention_case details reflecting applied changes.

functions.name: cancel_or_rollback_retention_offer
functions.description: Cancel a pending retention offer or rollback an already activated offer in case of error or customer withdrawal.
functions.returns: Result of cancellation or rollback action, including any residual adjustments and updated case/offer status.

functions.name: schedule_and_track_follow_up
functions.description: Create or update follow-up tasks and track post-retention outcomes for a customer.

task_id.description: If provided, update existing task; otherwise create new.

metadata.description: Arbitrary key-value extensions, like template IDs or survey channels.

post_retention_outcome.description: Optional explicit recording of medium-term outcome.

net_revenue_change.description: Change in monthly recurring revenue vs pre-case baseline.

functions.returns: Details of created/updated follow-up tasks and updated case outcome metrics if provided.

functions.name: search_retention_cases
functions.description: Faceted search across customer retention cases with rich filters, time windows, pagination, and aggregations.

facets.description: Facets to compute alongside the result set.

projection.description: Fields to include in the result objects.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A page of customer retention case summaries with facet aggregations, pagination cursor, and optional scoring metadata.

functions.name: bulk_create_retention_cases
functions.description: Create multiple customer retention cases in a single atomic or best-effort batch with idempotency and partial-commit options.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A bulk-job descriptor with per-item outcomes, created customer retention case ids, error reasons for failures, and an aggregate counts summary.

functions.name: bulk_update_retention_cases
functions.description: Apply patch-style updates to many customer retention cases with optimistic concurrency and partial-failure handling.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: Per-item update outcomes (success/failure with reason), new versions for each customer retention case, and a summary of skipped and quarantined items.

functions.name: bulk_archive_retention_cases
functions.description: Archive or soft-delete many customer retention cases in one call with retention, audit reason, and webhook notification.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: Per-id outcome, new lifecycle state for each customer retention case, scheduled purge date if applicable, and a job id for tracking.

functions.name: export_retention_cases
functions.description: Export customer retention case datasets to an external sink in CSV, JSON, Parquet, or NDJSON with filters and signed-URL delivery.

split_by.description: Field to shard output by, e.g., tenant_id.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: An export job descriptor with job id, estimated row count, signed-URL(s) when applicable, and asynchronous completion event details.

functions.name: import_retention_cases
functions.description: Bulk-import customer retention case records from a file or staging table with schema mapping, validation, and quarantine handling.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: An import job descriptor with counts of valid, invalid, and quarantined rows, sample error messages, and identifiers of created or updated customer retention cases.

functions.name: subscribe_to_retention_case_events
functions.description: Register a webhook or message-bus subscription to receive customer retention case lifecycle events with filtering and retry policy.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The created subscription record with id, secret rotation hint, active state, and an example test-event payload for the customer retention case.

functions.name: get_retention_case_audit_history
functions.description: Retrieve the immutable audit trail for a customer retention case, including who changed what, when, and from which channel.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A chronologically ordered list of audit entries for the customer retention case, each with actor, action, before/after diff, source, and optional evidence links.

functions.name: schedule_recurring_retention_case_job
functions.description: Create or update a recurring job for customer retention cases using cron, ISO interval, or calendar windows with backfill and concurrency controls.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The created or updated schedule descriptor with id, next run time, effective cron, and any backfill plan summary for the customer retention case action.

functions.name: simulate_retention_case_changes
functions.description: Preview the effect of a proposed change to a customer retention case without persisting, returning a diff and impact analysis.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A simulation report showing the resulting state of the customer retention case, a structured diff, policy-check verdicts, and a quantitative impact estimate (cost, latency, blast radius).

functions.name: request_retention_case_approval
functions.description: Create an approval workflow request for a customer retention case change, with multi-stage approvers, SLA, and evidence attachments.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: An approval-request descriptor with id, current stage, list of pending approvers, SLA deadlines, and links to the customer retention case under change.

functions.name: decide_retention_case_approval
functions.description: Record an approver decision (approve, reject, request changes) on a pending customer retention case approval request.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

expected_stage.description: Optimistic concurrency check on the approval stage.

functions.returns: The updated approval-request state including new stage, list of completed and pending approvers, and any condition list applied to the customer retention case.

functions.name: add_retention_case_comment
functions.description: Add a threaded comment, mention, or note to a customer retention case for collaboration and case-management context.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The persisted comment record with id, threading info, visibility, mention/notification fan-out summary for the customer retention case.

functions.name: upload_retention_case_attachment
functions.description: Upload or link a binary attachment (evidence, log bundle, screenshot, contract) to a customer retention case with scanning and retention.

inline_data.description: Base64 payload when kind is inline_base64.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The created attachment record with id, scan verdicts, signed download URL, checksum, and link to the customer retention case.

functions.name: create_retention_case_snapshot
functions.description: Capture an immutable point-in-time snapshot of a customer retention case (state, configuration, dependencies) for audit or rollback.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A snapshot record with id, size, checksum, encryption metadata, and a reference to the customer retention case version captured.

functions.name: restore_retention_case_from_snapshot
functions.description: Restore a customer retention case from a snapshot with selectable scope, validation pre-checks, and notification on completion.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A restore-operation descriptor with operation id, pre-restore snapshot id, validation results, conflict resolutions applied, and final state of the customer retention case.

functions.name: get_retention_case_metrics
functions.description: Compute and return KPI/metrics aggregates for customer retention cases over a time window with grouping, filters, and percentiles.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A metrics result with aggregate values, percentiles, optional period-over-period deltas, sparkline series per group, and the customer retention case domain context.

functions.name: get_retention_case_dashboard
functions.description: Return a pre-composed dashboard view for customer retention cases combining KPIs, alerts, top offenders, and time series.

personalize_for.description: User id to personalize widgets for.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A dashboard payload with KPI tiles, time-series data, top offenders, active alerts, and personalization metadata for the customer retention case context.

functions.name: create_retention_case_policy
functions.description: Create or update a policy/rule applied to customer retention cases with versioning, scope, and rollout strategy.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The created or updated policy record with id, version, rollout plan, scope, and an effective-evaluation summary against current customer retention cases.

functions.name: evaluate_retention_case_policy
functions.description: Evaluate one or more policies against a customer retention case in dry-run, returning per-rule verdicts and proposed actions.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: Per-policy and per-rule verdicts with reasons, trace data, and a list of proposed (or applied, when apply_actions=true) actions against the customer retention case.

functions.name: get_retention_case_dependency_graph
functions.description: Return the upstream and downstream dependency graph for a customer retention case including services, devices, tickets, and contracts.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A graph payload (nodes, edges, optional health and metrics) describing dependencies for the customer retention case, with depth and direction respected.

functions.name: link_retention_case_to_related
functions.description: Create or remove an association between a customer retention case and another business object (incident, ticket, contract, asset).

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The resulting association record (or removal confirmation) including direction, relation type, and a snapshot of the related-object summary for the customer retention case.

functions.name: assign_retention_case_owner
functions.description: Assign or reassign ownership/roles on a customer retention case with hand-off rules, watchers, and notification.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The updated assignment roster for the customer retention case with effective windows, hand-off receipts, and notification fan-out summary.

functions.name: tag_retention_cases
functions.description: Apply, remove, or replace tags and labels on one or more customer retention cases, with conflict resolution and audit.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: Per-id tag-application outcomes with final tag sets and counts of added/removed/skipped operations for each customer retention case.

functions.name: compare_retention_case_versions
functions.description: Produce a structured diff between two versions (or snapshots) of a customer retention case with semantic equivalence handling.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A diff document describing added, removed, and changed fields between the two versions of the customer retention case, with optional side-by-side rendering.

functions.name: configure_retention_case_retry_policy
functions.description: Configure default retry, backoff, and circuit-breaker policy applied to customer retention case operations and their downstream actions.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The persisted retry/circuit-breaker policy with id, effective scope, and a summary of customer retention case operations that match the new policy.

functions.name: check_retention_case_health
functions.description: Run a synthetic health/probe sweep against a customer retention case and its critical dependencies and return aggregated health status.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: Aggregated health verdict for the customer retention case, per-probe results, dependency roll-up, and any alert notifications dispatched.

functions.name: clone_retention_case
functions.description: Clone a customer retention case into a new instance with selective fields, optional rename, and link-back metadata.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The cloned customer retention case record with id, lineage link to the source, and a summary of fields reset, copied, or skipped.

functions.name: generate_retention_case_report
functions.description: Generate a formatted customer retention case report (executive, operational, compliance) and deliver via email/object storage.

schedule_id.description: When generated by a recurring schedule.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A report-generation receipt with report id, download URL or delivery confirmation, page/sheet count, and the customer retention case window covered.

functions.name: escalate_retention_case
functions.description: Escalate a customer retention case to a higher tier or owner group with reason, severity bump, and watcher fan-out.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The escalation record with new owner/tier, severity, SLA, watchers, and a log of notifications sent for the customer retention case.
